review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: brief-scaffold seeds measurement liveSelector/surfaceSelector/click targets to velt-*-wireframe REGISTRY tags, which Velt renders as 0x0 hidden twins at runtime; measure-block then captures an empty shell (exit 3) and BROWSER_PROBE marks every element MISSING — the entire scripted measurement + smoke pipeline is non-functional until briefs are re-keyed to real velt-*/.vc-* classes and a documentsReady content-wait is added
Velt v6 V1 sidebar default header renders Search+Status+FilterButton; a title/doc-id/badge header design requires the wireframe Header slot, not CSS
shadowDom:false strips Velt's internal sidebar panel layout CSS — the panel needs an explicit flex column + list-only scroll re-established or the header renders off-screen
Page-mode composer placeholder is set via the Composer.Input wireframe slot placeholder prop (IVeltCommentDialogComposerInputProps.placeholder), NOT the host commentPlaceholder prop
Composer.ActionButton type accepts file|userMentions|submit and mounts functional affordances (app-attachment-button / velt-autocomplete-tool / submit button)
capture-block.mjs single fresh context can stall on documentsReady and screenshot an empty rail — needs reload/re-auth/content-wait recovery before capture
